_comment: Quick-reply phrase bank. 'phrases' holds the English source lines. 'translations' is a cache keyed by language code then English phrase; entries are auto-filled by NLLB on first use and can be manually corrected/vetted by a native speaker - manual edits are never overwritten.
phrases: Please wait, a doctor will see you shortly.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Have you taken any medicine for this already?
We need to take a blood sample for testing.
We need to check your temperature and blood pressure.
Do you have any allergies or ongoing illnesses?
Please follow me to the examination room.
You are safe here, we will take care of you.
Do you have someone with you who can help translate?

sw.Please wait, a doctor will see you short: Tafadhali subiri, daktari atakuona hivi karibuni.
sw.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Je, tayari umepata dawa yoyote ya kuondoa ugonjwa huo?
sw.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Tunahitaji kuchukua sampuli ya damu kwa ajili ya mtihani.
sw.We need to check your temperature and bl: Tunahitaji kuangalia joto na shinikizo lako la damu.
sw.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Je, una allergies au ugonjwa unaoendelea?
sw.Please follow me to the examination room: Tafadhali nifuate hadi kwenye chumba cha uchunguzi.
sw.You are safe here, we will take care of: Wewe ni salama hapa, sisi kutunza wewe.
sw.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Je, una mtu yeyote pamoja nawe ambaye anaweza kusaidia kutafsiri?

rw.How long have you been feeling this way?: Ese umaze igihe kingana iki wumva umeze utyo?
rw.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ese waba waramaze gufata imiti yo kubigeraho?
rw.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Tugomba gufata ibipimo by'amaraso kugira ngo tugeragezwe.
rw.We need to check your temperature and bl: Tugomba kugenzura ubushyuhe n'umuvuduko w'amaraso wawe.
rw.Do you have any allergies or ongoing ill: Ese ufite allergie cyangwa indwara zikuremereye?
rw.Please follow me to the examination room: Ndakwinginze unkurikire ugere mu cyumba cy'imibonano mpuzabitsina.
rw.Do you have someone with you who can hel: Ese ufite umuntu ushobora kugufasha guhindura?

zu.How long have you been feeling this way?: Sekuphele isikhathi esingakanani uzizwa ngale ndlela?
zu.Have you taken any medicine for this alr: Ingabe usuvele uthatha imithi yokwelapha lokhu?
zu.We need to take a blood sample for testi: Sidinga ukuthatha isampula legazi ukuze silinge.
zu.We need to check your temperature and bl: Sidinga ukuhlola izinga lokushisa nengcindezi yegazi yakho.
